# function: bedrock_agentcore_paymentcredentialprovider

Builds the ARN for `bedrock-agentcore` `paymentcredentialprovider`:

```
arn:${Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${Region}:${Account}:token-vault/${TokenVaultId}/paymentcredentialprovider/${Name}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:token-vault/token-vault-id/paymentcredentialprovider/name
output "bedrock_agentcore_paymentcredentialprovider" {
  value = provider::arn::bedrock_agentcore_paymentcredentialprovider("token-vault-id", "name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
bedrock_agentcore_paymentcredentialprovider(token_vault_id string, name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `token_vault_id` (String) Value for `${TokenVaultId}` in the ARN template.
1. `name` (String) Value for `${Name}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
